labs.pi_title: Assistant Professor in the Departments of Marine & Environmental Sciences and Civil & Environmental Engineering
labs.research_summary: The Water Resources Ecohydrology Lab (WRElab) seeks to help better manage watersheds for the good of both people and nature in a shifting climate. To do so, we build new understanding of how watersheds function as systems, with interactions among meteorological forcing, geologic setting, and ecological process, and how these systems affect critical water resources.
